name: explorer-view
description: Standalone Explorer PWA (manifest + slim SW + share-target→OPFS). Dev HTTPS: CrossWord/CWSP-shared multi.crt; Port 443 may need privileges; npm run dev:8434 otherwise.

scripts.ssl:localhost: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout certs/key.pem -out certs/cert.pem -days 825 -subj '/CN=localhost'
scripts.ssl:link-multi: mkdir -p certs && ln -sfn ../../../apps/CrossWord/private/https/local/multi.crt certs/multi.crt && ln -sfn ../../../apps/CrossWord/private/https/local/multi.key certs/multi.key
scripts.build:cw-explorer: rm -rf ./build/cw-explorer && node ../CWSP-document/scripts/run-vite.mjs build --config vite.config.js --mode cw-explorer && node ./scripts/stage-cw-explorer.mjs
